title: Anton Paar launches new UNHT series for next-generation nanoindentation
summary: Anton Paar introduces the new UNHT Series, a new generation of nanoindentation systems designed to deliver reliable results, faster workflows, and greater versatility across a wide range of materials

extraction.key_fact: 안톤파가 다양한 소재 분석을 위한 차세대 나노인덴테이션 시스템인 새로운 시리즈를 출시했다.
